repo_notes.content: Tachyon is a native Markdown editor in Rust on GPUI (Zed's UI framework), with a 50 ms launch-to-first-frame budget. The authoritative documents are AGENTS.md (crate layout, invariants, commands), docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/ROADMAP.md and the decision records in docs/adr/. Where this wiki and those documents disagree, they win.

The mock editor in docs/design/concepts/ is a design concept image, not a feature list (ADR 0002 and docs/design/system/SNAPSHOT.md say where the repo departs from the design). Logo and icon files in assets/brand/ are generated by scripts/brand/ and are never hand-edited.

Core crates never depend on gpui: tachyon-text (rope buffer, undo), tachyon-md (Markdown to owned render IR) and tachyon-doc (document state, incremental reparse). Only tachyon-editor and the tachyon binary use GPUI, and only tachyon-platform contains per-OS cfg code.

pages.title: Architecture overview
pages.purpose: How the crates fit together, what depends on what, and why core crates never depend on gpui.

pages.title: Startup path and the 50 ms budget
pages.purpose: What runs before the first frame, how the startup bench gates it (cargo xtask bench-startup), and ADR 0004.

pages.title: Text buffer and undo
pages.purpose: The rope buffer, edit log, undo groups and UTF-16 mapping in crates/tachyon-text.

pages.title: Markdown parsing and the block IR
pages.purpose: How crates/tachyon-md turns Markdown into owned render blocks, including code highlighting.

pages.title: Document model and incremental reparse
pages.purpose: crates/tachyon-doc: block windows, ParseJobs and why every block must parse identically alone and in the document (ADR 0005).

pages.title: Editor view, block swap and rendering
pages.purpose: crates/tachyon-editor: the block-swap editing model (ADR 0002), rendering, theme, input and IME, view mode.

pages.title: Sticky notes
pages.purpose: Note windows, autosave, the notes state file, MD/TXT mode, view mode and the sticky folder (ADR 0010).
pages.parent: Editor view, block swap and rendering

pages.title: Platform integration
pages.purpose: crates/tachyon-platform: single-instance IPC, tray, global hotkey, always-on-top and Windows, Linux and macOS specifics.

pages.title: Sessions, hot exit and settings
pages.purpose: Hot exit backups (ADR 0006), session restore (ADR 0009), the settings file and the Preferences panel.

pages.title: Packaging and releases
pages.purpose: MSIX and App Installer, release.yml and nightly.yml, versions and channels (ADR 0007), and signing.

pages.title: Brand assets and the website
pages.purpose: The scripts/brand pipeline (ADR 0011), the design-system snapshot, and the site/ website with its Pages workflow.
